blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Stick your finger through your throat!
exercises.why: **Сквозь**, 'through' - this denotes the object through which another passes, as in 'The ball went through the window!'. **Через**, 'through'/'across' - the final preposition has two main meanings. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
exercises.context: Сквозь, 'through' - this denotes the object through which another passes, as in 'The ball went through the window!'.
